candidates.title: OpenAI prompt-to-voice creates reusable voices for GPT-Live agents
candidates.summary: OpenAI made prompt-to-voice generally available to API customers. Builders can create and save an adult synthetic voice from a text description, then use its voice ID in GPT-Live.
candidates.availability: Available to API customers through POST /v1/audio/voices. Prompt-generated voices work with GPT-Live only, with up to 100 prompt-generated voices per organization.
candidates.practical_use: Define a consistent adult voice for a support or onboarding agent, save the returned voice ID, add the original description to the GPT-Live session instructions, and evaluate it with a fixed script and conversation turns.

source_review.excerpt: Prompt-to-voice lets you create a new voice from a text description.
source_review.decision: Read the October 16 API changelog and full custom-voices guide. This is a documented walkthrough; AI Daily Diff did not create a voice or run GPT-Live.
source_review.availability: GA for API customers. Prompt-generated voices are limited to GPT-Live, billed through GPT-Live speech use, and the voice-creation endpoint is not compatible with Zero Data Retention.

candidates.practical_use: Inspect the notebook, rules and fixture logs, then reproduce the offline stages before deciding whether to use the model-assisted review.
